Description.Value: Comprehensive balance overhaul and essential UI enhancements. Tactical ability rebalancing, weapon/armor adjustments, facility improvements, QoL UI additions, and bug fixes from TFTV and original AA. Russian localization for all AAP text. AAP 1.2: fully localized Mod Options panel (EN+RU labels and tooltips via AAP_CFG_* keys), Phase 3 smart evacuation (partial-squad evac + follow-up prompt after a manual single evac), poison rework runtime enforcer (-50% Acc / -3 WP), extended base-facility popup, diagnostic logging, full Frenzy booster set (speed + willpower + damage), and a grenade-scatter toggle. Smart right-click guard: fixes accidental move orders (the menu-close double-click) while keeping RMB-move and vehicle controls intact. Native support for Festering Skies (Behemoth/flyer slowdown) and Corrupted Horizons (Acheron nerf) alongside Kaos Engines. Built against the current game build (evacuation tracker Init signature fix).
